{{Top|leg}}
{{Otheruses|Swoop}}
[[File:Swoopobiwana.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on a swoop]]
A '''swooper''' (also '''swooptroop''', '''swoop biker''', '''swoop racer''', '''swoop troop''', '''swoop trooper''', or '''swoop jockey'''<ref name=":MTS">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>) was an individual who rode a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]]. Around the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], most swoopers were criminals and members of [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gangs]]. Around 4000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier, [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] was a popular sport [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]], and particularly successful swoopers would rise to celebrity status.
